newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Indonesia buys 50,000 tonnes corn from Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia buys 50,000 tonnes corn from Argentina.

text.p: An Indonesian feed mill has bought some 50,000 tonnes of corn from Argentina for around US$142-$144 a tonne C&F for July shipment, dealers said on Thursday.
"The Indonesians recently bought the corn from Argentina," a dealer said.

Another trader said the Indonesian feedmill may have received a slight discount for the corn. Argentine corn coming into Southeast Asia was being quoted at around $144-$145 a tonne C&F on a Panamax for late June/July shipment.
Dealers said Indonesia may still be in the market for another shipment of anything from 20,000 to 50,000 tonnes of corn for the same period.
